hotel.name: La Reserve Geneve Hotel, Spa & Villa

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits in a landscaped park of 10 acres on the shores of Lake Geneva.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the heart of a beautifully landscaped park of 10 acres, on the shores of Lake Geneva...

verified_facts.text: The hotel is five kilometers from downtown Geneva.
verified_facts.excerpt: An invitation to travel, five kilometers from downtown Geneva

verified_facts.text: The hotel is 2 miles from the nearest international airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: just over 3 miles from the town center, 2 miles from the nearest international airport, on the shore of Lake Geneva

verified_facts.text: Tsé Fung serves Cantonese cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: the main act being the Cantonese, Michelin-starred Tsé Fung

verified_facts.text: Café Lauren is set at the heart of Spa Nescens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set at the heart of Spa Nescens, the Café Lauren creatively reconciles well-balanced cuisine and pampered tastebuds.

verified_facts.text: Le Loti is the hotel's restaurant and bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Loti Restaurant & Bar offers you a delicious culinary journey, where everyone is free to choose their favorite destination.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has outdoor and indoor swimming pools, a Kid's Club and sports facilities.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Spa Nescens, outdoor and indoor swimming pools, Kid’s Club, sports facilities, a range of à la carte activities…

verified_facts.text: Spa Nescens combines treatments, nutrition and physical activity.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spa Nescens offers you unique synergies between treatments, nutrition and physical activity in order to achieve visible and lasting results.

verified_facts.text: Spa services are provided by a team of therapists, coaches and medical specialists in preventive, anti-aging and aesthetic medicine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Services are provided by a multi-disciplinary team of therapists, coaches and medical specialists with expertise in the realms of preventive and anti-aging medicine, as well as aesthetic medicine.

verified_facts.text: Spa Nescens is recognised in the Vogue Global Spa Guide 2026 and received a Falstaff Spa Guide Award 2026 with 97 points.
verified_facts.excerpt: VOGUE GLOBAL SPA GUIDE 2026 & FALSTAFF SPA GUIDE AWARD 2026 \| 97 POINTS

verified_facts.text: The spa's fitness and relaxation area includes swimming pools, a fitness center, sauna, hammam and tennis courts.
verified_facts.excerpt: The fitness and relaxation areas (swimming pools, fitness center, sauna, hammam, tennis courts) are open daily

verified_facts.text: The spa offers a Rossano Ferretti Hair Spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rossano Ferretti Hair Spa

verified_facts.text: Admission to the spa is for clients aged 14 and over.
verified_facts.excerpt: Admission to the spa is for clients aged 14 and over

verified_facts.text: From June 1 to September 30 the indoor pool is reserved for adults and children aged 14 and over.
verified_facts.excerpt: From June 1 to September 30: the indoor pool is reserved for adults and children aged 14 and over.

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed in the spa, the outdoor pool and the surrounding area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pets are not allowed in the Spa Nescens, outdoor pool and surrounding area.

verified_facts.text: Guests can take a motoscafo boat ride between Geneva city center and the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy an exclusive motoscafo ride between Geneva city center and La Réserve Genève.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a villa, the Villa du Lac.
verified_facts.excerpt: Villa du Lac

verified_facts.text: Interiors follow an Old-World Africa theme reminiscent of luxury safari lodges.
verified_facts.excerpt: Interiors seize curiously but victoriously on an Old-World Africa theme, with gold, walnut, and berry shades; glowing lanterns; and dark polished floors reminiscent of the continent’s luxury lodges.

verified_facts.text: Rooms look over the gardens or the lake, and most have their own large terrace or balcony.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rooms either gaze down upon the topiary-trimmed gardens or out over the lake, most with their own large terraces or balconies.

verified_facts.text: Children can use an elaborate wooden playground.
verified_facts.excerpt: Children can tear through the elaborate wooden playground

verified_facts.text: The hotel has vintage motorboats for waterborne outings.
verified_facts.excerpt: embark on waterborne adventures aboard one of La Reserve’s vintage motorboats

verified_facts.text: Courchevel is about two hours from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Courchevel, a luxury haven in the Alps, offers a unique experience only two hours from La Réserve Genève.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a low-slung building alongside the lake.
verified_facts.excerpt: the low-slung La Reserve Hotel and Spa Geneva occupies a sizable, green patch alongside its namesake lake
